# iLoveMyFiles

Free, private browser-based file tools for images and PDFs. Everything runs locally in your browser - no file uploads, no sign-up required.

## Tools

- [Merge PDFs](/merge-pdf/) - Combine multiple PDF files into one document
- [Split PDF](/split-pdf/) - Extract pages or split into single-page files
- [Delete PDF Pages](/delete-pdf-pages/) - Remove unwanted pages from a document
- [Rotate PDF Pages](/rotate-pdf/) - Turn pages clockwise or anticlockwise
- [Resize PDF Pages](/resize-pdf/) - Change page size to A4, A3, Letter and more
- [Remove PDF Metadata](/remove-pdf-metadata/) - Clear title, author, keywords and dates
- [Compress PDF](/compress-pdf/) - Shrink PDF size with quality levels
- [Images to PDF](/image-to-pdf/) - Combine pictures into one PDF document
- [Add Page Numbers](/add-page-numbers-pdf/) - Stamp page numbers on every page
- [Watermark PDF](/watermark-pdf/) - Add diagonal text watermark
- [Image Converter](/image-converter/) - Convert between image formats
- [Image Compressor](/compress-image/) - Reduce image file size
- [Image Resizer](/resize-image/) - Set exact pixel dimensions
- [Crop Image](/crop-image/) - Drag to select area to keep
- [Rotate & Flip Image](/rotate-image/) - Turn and mirror images
- [Watermark Image](/watermark-image/) - Add text stamps to images
- [PDF to Images](/pdf-to-images/) - Render pages as PNG or JPG
- [Organize PDF Pages](/organize-pdf-pages/) - Reorder, duplicate or remove pages
- [JSON Formatter](/json-formatter/) - Format, minify and validate JSON
- [Base64 Encoder](/base64-encoder/) - Encode/decode Base64 text
- [Hash Generator](/hash-generator/) - Create SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 hashes
- [Word Counter](/word-counter/) - Count words, characters and reading time
- [JSON ↔ CSV](/json-to-csv/) - Convert between JSON and CSV
- [Unit Converter](/unit-converter/) - Convert data size, length, mass and time
- [OCR](/ocr/) - Extract text from images or PDFs
- [QR Code Generator](/qr-code-generator/) - Generate QR codes
- [Barcode Generator](/barcode-generator/) - Generate barcodes as PNG
- [Flatten PDF](/flatten-pdf/) - Render pages to images, removing text layer
- [Make PDF Searchable](/make-pdf-searchable/) - Add selectable text layer to scanned PDFs
- [CBSE Result Analyzer](/tools/cbse-result-analyzer/) - Turn a CBSE result gazette into marks, pass percentage and grade analytics (available to visitors in India)

## Privacy

All tools process files locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to a server.
